title: PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each s

translated_title: PrismGPT：基于代理引导学习与自合成推理的区域感知照片编辑
translated_abstract: 专业照片后期处理既依赖全局调整，也依赖由语义掩码引导的区域性局部编辑，然而当前的自动化方法只能部分地覆盖这一工作流程。我们提出了PrismGPT，这是一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，能够从单张输入图像生成结构化、区域感知的编辑计划，而无需依赖商业黑盒工具。由于组合决策空间极为庞大，训练一个VLM同时在全局与局部层面诊断美学缺陷并预测精确的编辑参数非常具有挑战性。我们通过代理引导学习来解决这一问题：两个更简单的代理任务——操作分解和区域感知美学排序——教会模型所需的基础技能，同时一个基于能力的动态调度器自动重新平衡多任务训练比例，随着各（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: PrismGPT是一个视觉-语言模型框架，通过操作分解与区域感知美学排序两个代理任务及基于能力的动态调度器实现代理引导学习，从而从单张图像生成兼顾全局与局部美学的结构化区域感知照片编辑计划。
en_tdlr: PrismGPT is a Vision-Language Model framework that generates structured, region-aware photo editing plans from a single image, using proxy-guided learning—two simpler proxy tasks plus a competence-based dynamic scheduler—to master both global and local aesthetic adjustments.
